description: This file defines the KmsMaterialsProviderV2 class, which implements encryption key management using AWS KMS for encrypting and decrypting data, specifically for use with V2 encryption clients like S3EncryptionClientV2.

classes.name: KmsMaterialsProviderV2
classes.description: A class that provides encryption materials using AWS KMS, supporting key wrapping and unwrapping for encryption workflows.

methods.name: getWrapAlgorithmName
methods.description: Returns the name of the key wrapping algorithm used, which is 'kms+context'.

methods.name: decryptCek
methods.description: Decrypts an encrypted content encryption key (CEK) using AWS KMS, with optional handling for any valid CMK.

methods.name: generateCek
methods.description: Generates a new data encryption key (DEK) using AWS KMS, with specified key size and encryption context.
